extensionName.message: Reels Flow: Auto Scroll for Instagram Reels
extensionName.description: Full extension name shown in the browser and on the stores.

extensionShortName.description: Short extension name, also the toolbar button tooltip.

extensionDescription.message: Watch Instagram Reels hands-free: Reels Flow moves to the next Reel when the current one finishes.
extensionDescription.description: Extension description shown in the browser and on the stores.

settingsPageTitle.description: Document title of the Settings Page.

popupAutoScroll.description: Popup switch that turns Auto-Scroll on or off.

popupReelControl.description: Popup switch that shows or hides the Reel Control, Reels Flow's Auto-Scroll button beside each Reel.

popupSettings.description: Popup button that opens the Settings Page.

popupReportProblem.description: Popup footer link to the Report Page.

popupSupport.description: Popup footer link to the Support Page, where a viewer can choose to donate. Shown after a heart.

reelControlName.description: What screen readers call the Reel Control, the Auto-Scroll on/off button beside each Reel.

reelControlLabel.description: Short label under the Reel Control's icon, like the counts under Instagram's own buttons.

reelControlTitle.description: Shown on hovering the Reel Control: what it does, and the Shortcut key that does the same.

settingsShortcuts.description: Settings Page heading over the list of Shortcuts, single keys that act on the Reels Feed.

settingsShortcutsHint.message: Single keys that work on Instagram Reels, except while you're typing. Click a key to change it.
settingsShortcutsHint.description: Settings Page text under the Shortcuts heading.

shortcutToggleAutoScroll.description: Settings Page name of the Shortcut that switches Auto-Scroll on or off.

shortcutNextReel.description: Settings Page name of the Shortcut that goes to the next Reel.

shortcutPreviousReel.description: Settings Page name of the Shortcut that goes back to the previous Reel.

settingsPressKey.description: Shown on a Shortcut's key on the Settings Page while it waits for the viewer to press its new key.

settingsKeyTaken.description: Settings Page notice when the viewer presses a key that another Shortcut already has; the key is not taken.

settingsResetShortcuts.description: Settings Page button that puts every Shortcut back to its default key.
